featured_reviews.name: Parth Javale
featured_reviews.review_text:
90 Degrees in Khar is hands down one of my favourite cake shops in Mumbai! Being a completely vegetarian place, the variety they offer is honestly impressive — from cakes and doughnuts to icecreams, savouries, namkeen, sweets, and so much more.

The staff here deserves a special mention. They’re extremely friendly and patient, and genuinely help you pick the best cake based on your preference. They also offer customisation, which is a big plus.

Their doughnuts are a must-try (so are the cakes!), and the savouries are just as good — the Italian sandwich and veg puff are absolutely delicious. And once you’re done with all that, don’t miss out on their fresh ice creams. There are so many flavours to choose from and they’re really refreshing.

Overall, a great place for desserts, quick bites, or even just to treat yourself. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: Great place for dessert. All of their products are really good. Staff is extremely friendly and kind. It's open till late as well which makes it even better. Seating available inside.

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Karangutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Gold by Ice Cream Works and had an absolutely delightful experience! We started with their 70% Dark Chocolate Ganache with Choco Rocks scoop — a dream for dark chocolate lovers. It was rich, with just the right balance of bittersweet notes, and the texture of the choco rocks added a perfect crunch, making it wonderfully pallete-balancing.

Next, we tried the Ferro Hazelnut, which was dipped in chocolate and absolutely delicious — a treat that beautifully captured the classic hazelnut and chocolate combination. As a healthier choice, we also sampled their Good-For-You Chocolate (pun game strong!) a chocolate ice cream sweetened with palm jaggery. The natural sweetness of the jaggery was spot on, making it feel indulgent yet light, and we appreciated the clever pun in the name!

The ambiance of the place was cozy and inviting, and the staff were extremely welcoming, cordial, and helpful in suggesting flavors based on our preferences. They made the experience even more enjoyable.

We also noticed an entire section dedicated to caramel ice-cream cakes, which looked very tempting — definitely on our list for the next visit! Plus, their Sundae menu is quite elaborate, offering plenty of options for those looking to indulge.

Overall, a must-visit spot for ice cream and dessert enthusiasts. Can’t wait to go back and try more!

featured_reviews.review_text: Totally obsessed with Ice Cream Works at Bandra! Their unique flavors and artistic presentation are a treat for the eyes and taste buds. The ambiance is super luxurious and perfect for a dessert date. Highly recommend for anyone with a sweet tooth.

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gold by ICW is located off Linking Road Bandra West and they have another outlet in Juhu.

The outlet is super bright, spacious and nicely made with the hint of gold colours used. The big display of the products looks excellent and everything is nicely placed here. Loved the seatings as it can accommodate all size of groups.

They specialise in premium flavours which are unique and give you an artisanal experience. Every flavour is amazing here and the menu is never ending. Also they have a kid centric special menu which is really good. Loved the sundaes as they are completely Instgrammable. Prices are on the higher side however the quantity and quantity are unmatched.

Went here after dinner and the staff were really polite and they knew their brand well. Special thanks to Manager Imran & Staff Tausif for their service.

What We Had -
SCOOPS~
3 Berries Cheesecake.
Biscotti Chocolate Cookie Fudge.
Both the flavours were bang on tasty and it was not overly sweet. The taste of tangy sweet berries was evident and the chocolate cookie fudge had cookie crumbs put nicely.

SUNDAES~
Chocolate in Gold Perfection.
Alphonso Mango.
They are the masters in preparing sundaes as the mix of flavours plus presentation is top class.  Chocolate in gold perfection was way too heavy for the appetite as it had everything related to chocolate in it. The best was the Alphonso mango from their limited edition menu which was outstanding.

MILKSHAKES~
Pistachio Opulence.
Alphanso Mango Milkshake.
Amazingly thick shakes made perfectly which tasted excellent. Loved the pistachio opulence and it should definitely be tried. Again not too sweet but tasty till the last drop.

So our dessert trip at Gold by ICW Bandra was something different as the Gourmet flavours and the classy outlet is something you need to visit for a memorable dessert experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
After a delicious dinner, we decided to end the night on a sweet note and stopped by By Ice Cream. It turned out to be the perfect choice for a decadent dessert experience!

Ambiance:

featured_reviews.name: Veikho Asanii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Affogato – a must-visit coffee and gelato outlet located on 17th Road in Khar West, Mumbai (near Bandra).
It looks tiny and unassuming from the roadside, but once you step inside, the stunning interior and inviting aroma of fresh coffee and gelato welcome you. The space feels like it was carved out of a smooth, swirling rock or cave — with soft curves, textured beige micro-concrete walls, ceiling, and floors inspired by gelato swirls. It's truly magical and artistic!
They offer two seating options: outdoor (without AC) and a cozy indoor AC room. The menu has a great variety of cakes, pastries, coffees, and, of course, their signature affogatos (espresso over gelato).
I tried their Cappuccino and Pain au Chocolat — both were excellent! The cappuccino came in a stylish glass cup, and the croissant was flaky, buttery, and perfectly chocolate-filled. Service was friendly and attentive.
One small downside: there's no strong AC blower at the entrance, so a few mosquitoes can be a minor nuisance (typical Mumbai evening issue in humid weather).
Overall, the experience was fantastic — highly recommended for any coffee or gelato lover in the city! ☕🍦✨

featured_reviews.name: Suhel Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked away in the quiet lanes of Khar, this café stands out with its bright presence and inviting, cozy interiors. The smooth textured walls, warm tones, and soft lighting create a soothing and relaxed ambiance. Even on a weekend, it wasn’t crowded, making it a perfect spot for some quiet time.

Seating is available both indoors and outdoors — though slightly limited and snug. I tried the avocado chicken, which came in a generous portion for the price and delivered beautifully on flavor. The iced mocha was made to perfection, and its pricing is pleasantly lower than most popular cafés around.

They also serve excellent gelatos, including sugar-free options sweetened with monk fruit — a thoughtful touch. Definitely planning to return to try those and the tempting quiche next time!

featured_reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried Affogato in Khar for the first time and I must say it was an absolute delight. I ordered the hazelnut affogato and it was heavenly. The blend of rich espresso poured over the creamy hazelnut gelato created the perfect balance of bitterness and sweetness. It was my first time trying an affogato and I’m so glad this was the place I chose to experience it.

The café itself has a very chic and calming vibe. It’s minimal in its design yet incredibly warm and welcoming. The use of earthy tones and the cozy setting give it a very homely feel. It’s the kind of place that instantly puts you at ease and makes you want to stay a little longer.

A big shoutout to Amit from the staff. He was genuinely sweet and courteous. We happened to be the last ones to place our order and despite the system being shut, when we expressed interest in trying the coffee gelato, Amit went out of his way to let us sample it in a small container. It was such a thoughtful gesture and honestly made our evening more special.

While everything we tried was good, the jamun sorbet truly stood out. It was refreshing, packed with flavor, and something I would go back for without a second thought.

Overall, Affogato has quickly become a new favorite. With its serene atmosphere, kind staff, and absolutely delicious offerings, I can definitely see myself visiting again and again.

featured_reviews.name: Rushabh Gundal
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a coffee and dessert enthusiast, discovering Affogato x Coffee by Javaphile was a delightful experience. This café offers a unique blend of Italian-inspired gelato and artisanal coffee, making it a must-visit for anyone who enjoys high-quality coffee and desserts.

Ambience & Design

The moment I walked in, I was captivated by the café's minimalist and modern design. The interiors have a soft, monochromatic palette inspired by swirling gelato, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere. The large, curved glass windows let in plenty of natural light, making it a perfect spot to unwind with a coffee. The outdoor seating area, surrounded by lush greenery and a calming white gravel setting, adds to the charm, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a peaceful break.

Menu Highlights

As the name suggests, Affogato x Coffee specializes in affogatos, and I couldn’t resist trying their signature affogato with Belgian Chocolate gelato. The combination of hot espresso and cold, velvety gelato was nothing short of amazing! They also have a great selection of gelato flavors, from Salted Butter Caramel to Tiramisu, all crafted using traditional Italian methods.

For those looking for something beyond affogatos, the café also offers freshly baked goods like Almond Croissants, Pain au Chocolat, and Cinnamon Rolls, which pair beautifully with their coffee. If you’re into unique coffee flavors, I highly recommend their Sea Salt Mocha or Spiced Latte—both have a perfect balance of richness and depth.

Service & Atmosphere

The staff here is friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about coffee and gelato. They are happy to guide you through the menu and help you find the perfect pairing. Another great thing is that this café is pet-friendly, making it a fantastic spot for those who want to enjoy their coffee with their furry friends.

Final Thoughts

Affogato x Coffee by Javaphile beautifully blends the art of gelato-making with specialty coffee, creating a haven for both dessert and coffee lovers. Whether you're craving a classic affogato, a scoop of creamy gelato, or a freshly brewed coffee, this place promises a memorable experience.

Would I visit again? Without a doubt!

featured_reviews.name: VlogWithFurkan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tender Fresh located in Kalina, and it was such a sweet experience! 🍦✨
They are currently running a Valentine’s special offer from 12th Feb to 18th Feb where you can buy 2 scoops and get 1 scoop absolutely FREE – which honestly makes it a perfect dessert date spot.
Talking about the taste, we tried their Mango Ice Cream which was super creamy and refreshing. The Chilli Guava Ice Cream was totally hatke – sweet with a spicy twist that actually works so well! Their Chocolate Ice Cream was rich and classic, perfect for chocolate lovers.
The Kala Jamun Shake was something unique and indulgent – proper desi flavour in shake form. And to end on a sweet note, we had their Baklava dessert which was perfectly sweet and satisfying.
They have a good variety of ice creams, shakes and special desserts, so there’s something for everyone. Overall, great taste, good quantity and value for money. Definitely recommended for couples, friends and even solo dessert dates!
Will surely visit again. 🍨❤️

featured_reviews.name: Gayatri
featured_reviews.review_text: If like me you crave something cool during winters then Tender fresh icecrean has to be your go to spot. From tasty scoops shakes to sundae desserts this place has it all. We tried the timeless scoops chilli guava and tender coconut and the seasonsl delight blueberry which were the most tasty ever. The baklava with a scoop of malai icecream caught our attention which was a tasteful delight. Simply mesmerised by their falooda icecream which had a geberous scoops of dry fruit icrcream, kesar pista and falooda the service was quick and friendly staff. Loved their presentations and serve size. Ended our cravings with a chikoo shake taste and quality guaranteed

featured_reviews.review_text: this is the best place to try nutty baklava and icecreams in kalina. they have amazing taste and variety of flavours available. featured_reviews.name: rumana patel
featured_reviews.review_text:

Great quality and flavours. Highly recommend 🍨✨

featured_reviews.name: Dreams unlimited By Divya joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had such a lovely experience at Tender Fresh ❤️
Tried their Chickoo ice cream, Choco Chips, Sundae, Dry Fruit Shake and Hazelnut — and honestly everything tasted super fresh, rich and delicious! 😍 The flavors were really good and the quality felt premium, especially the creamy texture and perfect sweetness.
The staff and service were equally amazing. Everyone was polite, friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. 😊 The outlet was clean, nicely maintained and had a very positive vibe.
A great place to chill, enjoy desserts and spend quality time with family or friends. Definitely visiting again soon! 🍨💖

featured_reviews.name: bindi yajnik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tender Fresh is a total dessert delight!
Creamy texture, rich flavours, and a premium feel in every scoop. The Biscoff ice cream is a must-try, and their chocolate-based flavours are super indulgent.
Perfect spot to satisfy sweet cravings. Definitely adding this to my repeat list
The sundae ice cream was rich and indulgent, and the chocolate milkshake was thick, creamy, and perfectly chocolaty. Fresh flavours, great quality, and totally worth it. A must-visit for dessert lovers

featured_reviews.name: Faisal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Surely an Hidden Gem Alert for All Dessert Lovers! 🍨✨

Visited Tender Fresh Ice Cream on Santacruz Kalina Road and was blown away by their range of desserts. Tried the Nutty Baklava with Malai Ice Cream topped with honey and nuts — absolutely too good! The Sitafal Thick Shake and Chocolate Shake were both rich, creamy, and solid in taste.

Also indulged in their Dry Fruit Ice Cream in a Waffle Cone, along with Seasonal Blueberry and Chilli Guava flavors — each one stood out with awesome quality and freshness.

The place has a superb ambience and lovely vibes, making it a perfect spot to chill and satisfy your dessert cravings.
